what_changed: July CPI came in as expected (0.1% m/m, 3.4% y/y) and lighter-than-expected PPI eased yields; VIX fell to 14.6. Al Jazeera says attacks dent Hormuz reopening hopes, but crude was flat on the day after an 11% week. A Reuters commentary called the copper move a 'Congo panic'; copper and FCX paused but no reversal of the ban was reported.

oil_gas.why: Unnamed attacks on a stalled Hormuz reopening come after an 11% crude rebound, so they are priced; no new sanctions or named escalation.

gold_miners.why: NEM is up 24% in a month and the Headwater Nevada stake is minor; no fresh catalyst.

chips.why: Only a technical note on NVDA; sector bounce is not a catalyst; earnings in late August add variance.

pharma.why: Drift after the Q2 guidance raise with no pricing or compounding headline against it.

copper_uranium.why: Congo concentrate export ban still in force; Reuters commentary frames it as a tight market, not a reversal.

lessons.rule: Hypothesis only: oil longs opened on a named supply-shock escalation headline win over 10 days; late entries after a long run do worse.
lessons.evidence: Supporting: XOM 07-07 +6.82%, 07-10 +12.76%, 07-15 +8.22%, 07-20 +4.27%. Contradicting: XOM 07-23 -1.56% (entered after Brent >$100). Net 3; one Iran episode only. Does not change calls.

lessons.rule: Hypothesis only: pharma drift holds after a trial or guidance catalyst earn about zero after costs.
lessons.evidence: LLY 07-23 +0.21%, LLY 07-28 -0.76% (both beat the family basket). Too few cases; does not change calls.
